turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm feeling a bit groggy, but okay lah. My left hip is sore, but not too bad.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Can you rate your pain for me on a scale from 0 to 10, where 0 is no pain and 10 is the worst pain?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'd say around 4 or 5. The epidural seems to be helping a lot.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good to hear. Have you experienced any nausea or vomiting since the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No nausea, thank goodness. I was worried about that, but I feel fine.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. How about your breathing? Are you comfortable, or do you feel any shortness of breath?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Breathing is fine. A bit of discomfort when I move, but I can breathe normally.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Do you remember anything from the operating room or immediately after surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Not really. I knew I was going in, and then I woke up here. So I guess the anesthesia worked well.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That's expected with general anesthesia. Given your history of hypertension and diabetes, are you experiencing any unusual symptoms like dizziness, blurred vision, or chest discomfort?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, nothing like that. Just the usual aches from the surgery.
